english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for soothing someone who is upset, distressed, or crying.
Use this casual verb when you cheer someone up or coax them into a happier mood.

examples.english: Don't cry, I'll soothe you a bit.
examples.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 haam3 laa1 ngo5 tam5 haa5 nei5

examples.english: That joke helped cheer me up.
